messages:
elena: heads-up: after the RBAC role rename this morning, SCIM bulk provision is failing for ~420 users. seeing KMS errors in audit logs.

raj: ugh, timeline?

elena: spotted around 09:12 UTC. root decrypt fails with `InvalidEncryptionContext` when processing the provision payload. logs: 
```
scim-provisioner ERROR decrypt failed: InvalidEncryptionContext: provided encryption context does not match
resource=provision/user batch=bulk-2026-03-20
```

sam: did we rotate the KMS key yesterday?

tim: yes, key rotation completed 02:47 UTC. updated most services that call kms:Decrypt but might have missed scim-provisioner.

raj: SCIM service uses envelope encryption with encryption_context = {"org_id": "redwood-prod", "scim_version": "v2"}. if that context string changed (even subtle char changes) decrypt will fail.

elena: also noticed Okta SCIM connector mapping changed externalId -> email for some exports after the mapping tweak.

infra-bot: deploy 1918.124 applied to `scim-provisioner-prod` at 09:00, config `KMS_KEY_ALIAS=alias/redwood-main` unchanged.

sam: can someone run a decrypt test from the scim-provisioner instance with the failing ciphertext? sample id: ci-0a9f3b

raj: running now. note: if it's encryption-context mismatch decrypt will error even with correct key.

raj: replicable: AWS CLI decrypt fails with InvalidEncryptionContext:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --encryption-context '{"org_id":"redwood-prod","scim_version":"v2"}'
# -> InvalidCiphertextException / InvalidEncryptionContext
```

tim: so who encrypted it originally? The connector? When we rotated keys two things could have happened: connector re-encrypted with new context, or we didn't update context in one of the services.

elena: root cause hypothesis: RBAC rename modified `org_id` metadata in the user export job, changing the encryption context from `redwood-prod` to `redwood_prod` (dash -> underscore). tiny string change breaks decrypt.

sam: can we confirm by trying decrypt with the underscore variant?

raj: tried both — decrypt succeeds with `{"org_id":"redwood_prod","scim_version":"v2"}`. so export job definitely changed formatting.

elena: where did that touch come from? migration PR #487 by platform-identity changed slug normalization.

tim: PR author was jia — tagging @jia to confirm.

jia: yup, that migration normalized slugs to underscores internally. didn't realize it touched encryption context strings. sorry — i can revert or add compatibility.

sam: mitigation options: revert migration (fast), accept both contexts in decrypt logic (fallback), re-encrypt existing ciphertexts with new context (expensive), or roll forward and update connectors. KMS only validates exact context, so we can't pass multiple contexts to decrypt.

raj: practical short-term: implement decrypt fallback in scim-provisioner: try old context, if fails try new, emit auditable event when fallback used. then revert migration or update config for long-term.

elena: good. also need to update customer success if provisioning stalls >1h.

sam: I'll open an incident and prepare rollback if hotfix fails.

infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-033 severity=high channel=eng-security.

jia: i'll submit a PR to revert the slug change for now then follow up with a configurable context option.

tim: action items:
- sam: hotfix scim-provisioner to attempt both contexts + detailed audit logs (ETA 45m)
- jia: revert PR / add config for encryption context (ETA 30m)
- raj: run batch decrypt test on sample failing ciphertexts and validate (ETA 20m)
- elena: notify CS if provisioning delayed >1h (ETA immediate)

sam: deploying hotfix to canary now.

sam: canary shows success for 12/12 failing users; fallback decrypt worked.

elena: pushing to prod.

infra-bot: deploy 1918.125 applied to scim-provisioner-prod at 10:05.

raj: post-deploy verification: bulk queue cleared, 418 pending processed, audit logs show `decrypt_context_mismatch_resolved` tagged on those items.

elena: closing incident after 30m quiet monitoring.

sam: will follow up with migration ticket to re-encrypt stored blobs and schedule short maintenance window.

jia: adding extra tests to PR template to prevent context-sensitive changes from slipping by.

tim: thanks all. please add a short postmortem and link it here when ready.
